stories.headline: Social media addiction lawsuit against Meta is dropped
stories.dek: A closely watched social media addiction lawsuit that had been set to go to trial next week has been dropped after the plaintiff voluntarily dismissed his claims against Meta, leaving none of the major tech companies facing trial in the case.

stories.headline: SoundCloud acquires decentralized music platform Nina Protocol months after its shutdown
stories.dek: SoundCloud has acquired decentralized music platform Nina Protocol, months after the startup announced it would shut down. The deal brings Nina’s artists, editorial archive, and music discovery tools to SoundCloud as the company continues expanding its platform for independent musicians.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Rachit Tank on Unsplash

stories.headline: How OpenAI’s human mistake led to the AI-powered hack on Hugging Face
stories.dek: OpenAI made a mistake setting up what it called a “highly isolated” testing environment and sandbox. According to cybersecurity experts, that human mistake is what made the AI-powered attack on Hugging Face possible.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Brecht Corbeel on Unsplash
